name: Nova Jupyter Bridge
description: Privacy-friendly Jupyter integration for Nova. Choose between the custom Notebook Studio and official JupyterLab. Features include individual-cell execution, Python debugging, verified breakpoints, execution-line highlighting, kernel management, and standard Jupyter notebook support.

configWorkspace.title: Python executable
configWorkspace.description: Python executable used by both Notebook Studio and JupyterLab. Select your existing Python environment containing jupyter_client, ipykernel, and JupyterLab. You can specify the full path to the Python executable. No additional Python environment is created.

configWorkspace.title: Notebook Studio kernel override
configWorkspace.description: Optional kernel override for Notebook Studio. Leave empty to use the kernel specified by the notebook. For Python debugging, select a kernel that supports the Jupyter debugger protocol.

configWorkspace.title: Attempt automatic Nova Preview navigation
configWorkspace.description: When enabled, attempts to open Notebook Studio or JupyterLab inside Nova Preview using macOS System Events and Accessibility automation. If automatic navigation is unavailable, the private local URL is copied to the clipboard and manual instructions are displayed. macOS permissions may be required.
